author: Scopoli, 1769
status: 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 나그네새 수십 마리
habitat: 돌이 많은 산지의 풀밭, 바위 틈(둥지)

months.note: 10월 중순에 와서 이듬해 4월 초까지 높은 산의 바위 지대에서 겨울을 나며, 번식지인 일본에서는 6~7월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 돌이 많은 산지의 풀밭에 사는 새로, 북부 지역에서는 텃새이고 중부 이남에서는 늦가을에 내려와 겨울을 나는 드문 겨울철새이다. 바위 틈에 벼과 식물의 이삭·줄기·잎이나 이끼로 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 짓고 6~7월에 알 3~4개를 낳는다. 곤충을 주로 먹지만 열매와 씨도 먹는다. 국내에서는 북부 지방, 경상북도, 경기도에 살고, 국외에서는 남부 유럽에서 아시아 동부까지 분포한다.

points.ko: 검은 갈색 무늬의 잿빛 갈색 등

points.en: dark chestnut undertail coverts fringed white

young: 어른새보다 전체적으로 갈색이 돌고 칙칙하며, 멱에 검은 점무늬가 없고 가슴과 배에 흑갈색 얼룩이 있다. 옆구리의 적갈색도 어른새보다 적다.

art.subject: Alpine Accentor (Prunella collaris), adult (sexes alike) in late autumn and winter: head and neck ash-grey; chin and throat whitish, finely barred black so they look chequered at close range; breast brownish ash-grey; mantle and back grey-brown with bold blackish-brown streaks; wing coverts blackish with neat white tips forming a row of white spots, flight feathers dark brown with rufous-buff edges; flanks and sides of the belly white, heavily streaked chestnut-rufous; undertail coverts dark chestnut with white fringes; tail dark brown with pale tips; bill blackish with a yellow base to the lower mandible; dark brown eye; reddish-brown legs.
art.pose: foraging on the ground among stones, side view
art.scene: Korean rocky mountain grassland with scattered boulders in late autumn; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view on a rock: ash-grey head and neck, finely barred whitish throat, brownish-grey breast, grey-brown back streaked blackish, white-spotted black wing coverts, white flanks heavily streaked chestnut, reddish-brown legs
adult, low view from below and behind: dark chestnut undertail coverts with white fringes, chestnut-streaked white belly sides, dark tail with pale tips
art.build: Stocky, robust ground bird, 18cm, clearly larger and plumper than a sparrow. Low, horizontal stance, shuffling and hopping among rocks and short grass. Head rounded, neck short. Bill fine and pointed, shorter than the head, not finch-like. Legs short to medium, reddish-brown. Tail medium length and square. In flight the black-and-white spotted wing coverts and pale tail tips show.
avoid: Do not paint a black crown and mask with an orange-buff supercilium — that is Siberian Accentor (Prunella montanella).
Do not give it a thick, conical finch bill; the bill is thin and pointed.
Do not paint plain, unstreaked flanks; they carry bold chestnut streaks.
Do not perch it high in trees; it feeds on the ground among rocks and stones.
